title: Strategic Real Estate, Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:
    • Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;
    • Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;
    • Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;
    • Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.
  • Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.
  • Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.
  • Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.
  • Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.


Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.
  • Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.
  • Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.

title: Manager, Electrode Process Engineering, Operations
description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Process Engineering Manager to oversee our Electrode Manufacturing Operations. In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians responsible for the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our electrode production lines — spanning powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation processes. You'll bring strong technical judgment grounded in material science, along with a data-driven approach, to guide your team in diagnosing process issues, prioritizing improvement projects, and implementing robust, high-impact solutions on the floor. You will own staffing, coaching, and performance management for your team, while partnering with cross-functional engineering leaders to translate process and materials insights into meaningful, lasting manufacturing improvements. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your process engineering background, materials expertise, and leadership experience to build a world-class, fully automated electrode production process.

Relocation assistance is available. 

What you'll do:

Own the section's operating results across powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation, holding your team accountable for line cadence, downtime, and overall throughput

Manage and develop a small, mostly-engineer team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians, including staffing, coaching, and performance decisions

Establish and track section-level metrics (OEE, yield, cycle time) and direct resourcing toward the highest-impact bottlenecks across each process step

Set methods and standards for evaluating and vetting floor-level solutions, ensuring fixes across the powder-to-tape process are safe, robust, and grounded in sound material science before scale-up

Represent the section in cross-functional planning with peer engineering and manufacturing teams, resolving constraints that affect quality and throughput company-wide

Build and prioritize a continuous improvement roadmap for the section, balancing waste reduction, ergonomics, and process reliability against production demands

What you'll bring:

Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or related field

7+ years in manufacturing/production operations, including team management experience

Strong material science foundation — able to connect powder properties and tape mechanics to process outcomes

Proven track record hiring, developing, and managing process/equipment engineers or technicians

Deep familiarity with manufacturing metrics (OEE, downtime) and a root-cause approach to problem-solving

Working knowledge of roll-to-roll processes — powder transformation, mixing, web handling

Strong influencing skills and experience representing your team's priorities to peer managers and engineering leadership

Pragmatic, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity as the organization scales

Where you'll work:

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.

#LI-Onsite

#LI-LN1

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 

To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.

If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.

  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring.

    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.

You will own and manage service goals that may span multiple organizations and teams within multiple subject areas simultaneously. Business-impacting projects you would be responsible for will enhance data center operations efficiency. It is expected that these projects require timely execution with the highest degrees of safety, security, performance, availability and reliability. Our ideal candidate is an articulate, motivated, and organized individual with experience in leading global initiatives at an enterprise scale. The role requires the ability to quickly assimilate knowledge spanning numerous technology subjects and apply this to data center projects, products and operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 

Key job responsibilities

Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPI's) and Organizational goals tracking dynamic cross-organizational programs and products.

Coordinate effective cross-organizational engagements to drive closure on long standing, complex, and often ambiguous problem sets.

Own one or more highly visible, complex, cross-functional projects from end to end; including product definition, roadmap planning, resource planning and project execution.

Be Accountable for the overall strategy as well as driving tactical delivery of key deliverables through partner teams and stakeholders.

Build and maintain relationships with key owners and stakeholders across teams and organizations.

Escalate and engage partner teams and leadership as needed to drive attainment of key program deliverables and objectives.

Synthesis large and complex data sources and program details into concise narratives and program status reports.

Be data-driven and understand how to identify the right data points to effectively articulate the What, Why, and How of in scope projects. 

A day in the life

Production control means integrating with our upstream teams, interfacing with their process's and define how capacity comes to Operations. Ensure customer requests are fulfilled or escalated. It is a constant flow from our production lines out of manufacturing into the data centers and we will be leaning in to help stabilize ask and plans to ensure we have the right resources in front of capacity landings. 

About the team

We work in the Central Operations space, created to help stabilize and optimize the capacity signals from our customers to the DC Operations teams.

Work through these changes and put together plans to meet customern eeds and drive down defects.

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/11/2026
Candidate must relocate or live in the listed territory

Westcoast

Meet the Team

You will join an elite, mission-driven sales organization within Cisco’s U.S. Federal Defense operation dedicated to empowering the United States Air Force and Space Force. As a Senior Account Executive supporting the US Air Force, you will play a critical role in enabling the mission readiness, secure digital modernization, and warfighter capabilities of our defense customer.

Serving as the Account Orchestrator, you will build and manage multi-year strategic relationships across designated Air Force commands and regional installations (such as Peterson SFB, Schriever SFB, Buckley SFB, Cheyenne Mountain, and the U.S. Air Force Academy). You will partner closely with Portfolio Solutions Engineers, Architecture Specialists, and executive defense leadership to drive sustainable, cross-portfolio growth and align Cisco's industry-leading technology with customer mission imperatives.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Account Orchestration & Deal Leadership: Orchestrate multi-faceted, highly complex deal cycles ($100K to $30M+) involving multiple stakeholders, defense commands, and program offices to drive impactful revenue growth and mission transformation.

Air Force Executive & Flag-Level Engagement: Engage with senior military and civilian leaders across the Air Force and Space Force, serving as the primary trusted advisor and commercial influencer in purchasing decisions.

Cross-Portfolio & Secure Networking Positioning: Drive sustainable cross-portfolio growth with deep expertise in core secure networking (enterprise switching, routing, wireless, and next-generation firewall), while collaborating with specialist teams on advanced security, cloud, and observability architectures.

Opportunity Qualification, Funnel Velocity & Forecasting: Build a robust sales pipeline through proactive opportunity prospecting; manage opportunities through all deal stages; maintain accurate representation in Cisco CRM; and analyze data to deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales commitments.

Consultative Deal Structuring & Negotiations: Lead commercial and contract negotiations with a consultative approach, expertly balancing competitive pricing, service level agreements, and multi-year federal contractual commitments (SEWP, GSA, DoD Enterprise Agreements).

Cross-Functional Teaming & Partner Teaming: Direct and align extended team resources (Portfolio SEs, TSAs, Services, RevOps, Legal, and Finance) and coordinate with defense ecosystem partners to deliver unified customer outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ to 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise technology sales, strategic business development, or defense IT account management experience.

Demonstrated track record of successfully managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles ($1M+ to $10M+) and achieving annual sales quotas.

Solid foundational knowledge of enterprise networking and cybersecurity architectures, with specific focus on core secure networking (switching, routing, wireless, and firewall).

Proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional sales engineering, product specialist, legal, and commercial teams to navigate complex federal procurement cycles.

U.S. Citizenship required to comply with federal customer site access, background investigation, and security clearance requirements.

Ability to work in a hybrid, field-based model located in or near Denver, Colorado with travel to regional military installations and partner sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (with 5+ years of experience), Master’s degree (with 3+ years of experience), or equivalent practical experience in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Extensive experience selling enterprise software, hardware, or cloud solutions directly to the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), specifically the U.S. Air Force or U.S. Space Force.

Active U.S. Government Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret / SCI).

Prior military service or experience working within defense acquisition commands (AFMC, AFLCMC, SSC, ACC, AMC, NORAD/USNORTHCOM).

Familiarity with DoD procurement contract vehicles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS), and multi-year enterprise software agreements (DoD ESI, 2GIT, NASA SEWP).

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sr Portfolio Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Portfolio Manager based in the United States.

The Senior Portfolio Manager will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across a portfolio of federal government programs, ensuring successful delivery, financial performance, and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will manage complex projects, oversee multidisciplinary teams, and build strong relationships with senior government stakeholders. You will be responsible for balancing program execution, personnel management, contractual compliance, and business growth initiatives. Working closely with delivery, finance, recruiting, and business development teams, you will identify opportunities to expand existing accounts while maintaining operational excellence. You will also drive workforce development, resource planning, and performance management to ensure teams are equipped to meet evolving customer needs. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong background in federal programs, consulting, and cybersecurity to make a significant impact in a dynamic, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities:

Program and Delivery Management

Provide executive oversight of programs, projects, and task orders within the assigned customer portfolio.

Ensure all engagements are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual obligations and customer expectations.

Develop and monitor project plans, milestones, staffing requirements, dependencies, risks, and corrective actions.

Ensure contractual deliverables meet quality standards and are submitted accurately and on time.

Identify and escalate delivery, staffing, financial, and customer-related risks, driving issues through resolution.

Maintain strong customer relationships and serve as the primary escalation point for program delivery matters.

Capture program achievements, performance metrics, and success stories to support business development activities.

Personnel Management and Supervision

Provide first-line supervision, daily guidance, coaching, and performance management for assigned employees.

Establish clear performance expectations and align individual objectives with project, account, customer, and organizational goals.

Conduct regular one-on-one meetings to discuss performance, workload, professional development, engagement, and employee concerns.

Complete performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback, recognition, and development recommendations.

Identify opportunities for employee growth through training, certifications, professional development, and career advancement.

Address performance and conduct issues in coordination with Human Resources and delivery leadership.

Review and approve timecards, leave requests, and other personnel actions in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.

Monitor employee utilization, workload, availability, and assignments to ensure effective resource deployment.

Support employee retention by proactively addressing engagement, career development, workload, and assignment concerns.

Participate in recruitment, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, promotions, resource assignments, and offboarding activities.

Maintain regular communication with remote employees and personnel working at customer locations to promote engagement and organizational alignment.

Coordinate staffing transitions and succession planning to maintain continuity of service delivery.

Account Growth and Business Development

Develop and execute strategic account growth plans for assigned customer groups.

Identify opportunities to expand existing programs through additional scopes of work, task orders, contract vehicles, and adjacent customer requirements.

Establish and monitor account-level targets for revenue, backlog, funded work, and workforce growth.

Collaborate with business development and capture teams to identify, qualify, shape, and pursue new business opportunities.

Maintain awareness of customer priorities, budgets, acquisition strategies, upcoming procurements, and competitive activity.

Translate anticipated growth opportunities into staffing and recruitment forecasts to ensure appropriate resources are available.

Customer Relationship Management

Serve as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for key customer stakeholders.

Build and maintain relationships with government program leaders, contracting representatives, technical leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.

Conduct regular customer meetings and account reviews to assess performance, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.

Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address concerns or service delivery issues.

Ensure delivery teams understand changing customer mission requirements and strategic priorities.

Balance customer expectations with responsibility for employee performance, professional development, and well-being.

Contract Compliance and Administration

Maintain oversight of contractual requirements, including scope, funding, performance periods, labor categories, staffing, deliverables, and reporting obligations.

Partner with Contracts and Finance teams to ensure compliance with contract terms and applicable government and organizational requirements.

Monitor contract funding, burn rates, ceilings, option periods, and key milestones.

Coordinate with Finance to ensure contract and project information within Unanet is accurate and regularly updated.

Ensure employees are assigned to authorized labor categories, work locations, and contractual responsibilities.

Promote compliance with customer requirements, security policies, timekeeping procedures, and internal standards.

Financial and Operational Management

Maintain accountability for the financial performance of the assigned account and its underlying programs.

Monitor revenue, labor utilization, project costs, profit margins, forecasts, and other financial performance indicators.

Maintain approximately 50% individual billable utilization through direct customer engagement or program delivery, balancing these responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel supervision, and business development.

Ensure accurate and timely employee and subcontractor timekeeping, with appropriate project and contract charge codes.

Review and approve personnel time records in accordance with established procedures.

Support accurate and timely customer invoicing and resolve billing discrepancies.

Work with Finance to maintain reliable revenue, resource, and staffing forecasts.

Identify financial and operational variances and implement appropriate corrective actions.

Performance Metrics and Reporting

Establish and maintain account-level performance scorecards.

Track key indicators, including revenue, margins, staffing, headcount, utilization, vacancies, deliverable status, customer satisfaction, invoice status, contract funding, burn rates, and growth pipeline.

Provide regular performance reports and financial forecasts to the Federal Services Director.

Maintain visibility into program risks, issues, opportunities, and corrective actions.

Deliver accurate and timely reporting to support leadership decisions and resource allocation.

Team and Organizational Leadership

Provide leadership and direction to Program Managers, Project Managers, technical leads, and other delivery professionals.

Build cohesive account teams with clear responsibilities across delivery, personnel management, customer engagement, and business development.

Maintain appropriate staffing levels and proactively address recruitment, retention, performance, and succession planning needs.

Partner with Recruiting and Human Resources to forecast workforce requirements and fill critical positions.

Promote accountability, communication, collaboration, and consistent delivery practices.

Mentor high-performing employees, delegate responsibilities, and develop future organizational leaders.

Foster a culture of customer service, professional development, operational excellence, and accountability.

Key Deliverables

Develop engagement delivery plans, staffing strategies, and project status reports.

Produce utilization and capacity forecasts aligned with active engagements and business development opportunities.

Prepare engagement financial reports covering budgets, gross margins, and profitability.

Develop Statements of Work (SOWs), change orders, and contract compliance documentation.

Create team development plans, performance reviews, and certification or upskilling roadmaps.

Contribute to delivery methodologies, templates, service catalogs, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Produce thought leadership materials, including white papers, blog posts, and technical accelerators, and represent the organization at relevant industry events.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related discipline.

7–10+ years of relevant professional experience, including at least 3 years managing consulting or professional services teams and/or overseeing federal programs.

Demonstrated ability to balance direct, billable customer delivery responsibilities with portfolio leadership, personnel management, financial oversight, and business development.

In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity and information security domains, including cloud security, endpoint protection, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

Familiarity with established security frameworks and standards, such as NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

Experience with project management methodologies, tools, and program delivery practices.

Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP are strongly preferred.

Strong leadership and people management capabilities, with experience coaching, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary teams.

Excellent communication, organizational, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong financial and operational management abilities, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.

Proven ability to manage multiple complex engagements while maintaining quality, contractual compliance, and customer satisfaction.

Ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance is required.

Experience building or scaling professional services or engineering teams is preferred.

Previous experience in fast-paced consulting environments is highly desirable.

High levels of integrity, accountability, adaptability, and strategic thinking.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation: Attractive salary package, paid twice monthly.

Annual performance bonus: Additional compensation tied to business segment results.

Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive medical insurance, with 100% of medical premiums covered by the employer.

Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with a 100% company match on the first 4% of eligible contributions.

Paid time off: Three weeks of PTO starting from the first year of employment.

Paid holidays: 11 paid holidays annually.

Family support: Paid maternity and paternity leave.

Remote work support: Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and home internet expenses.

Business development incentives: Companywide incentive programs rewarding contributions to new business opportunities.

Thought leadership incentives: Recognition and incentives for producing white papers, blog posts, internal webinars, and other knowledge-sharing contributions.

Professional growth: Opportunities to contribute to technical initiatives, develop expertise, and support organizational innovation.

Flexible work environment: Remote working arrangement within the United States.

title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Strategy & Prioritization

Program Management

Learning Transformation Portfolio Delivery Lead (18 months FTC)

Macclesfield, United Kingdom  (3 days on site per week)

 

About AstraZeneca

At AstraZeneca, we’re not afraid to do things differently. We’re building a new kind of organization to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening new ways to work, pioneering innovative methods and bringing unexpected teams together.

 

Lead the delivery of a global enterprise learning transformation portfolio, with the replacement of the global Learning Management System as the immediate and primary licence-to-operate programme. Alongside the LMS, you will oversee the delivery of AI-enabled Learning Content Services and the refresh of the wider learning technology ecosystem, ensuring the programmes operate as an integrated portfolio and deliver measurable, sustainable enterprise outcomes.

Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Learning Services and Solutions, you will lead the portfolio delivery function, integrating plans, resources, investment, risks, dependencies, decisions and benefits. You will direct Programme Managers and the PMO, establish clear delivery standards and priorities, and provide the assurance and executive insight required to keep this complex transformation focused and on course.

 

You will create an environment where governance enables timely decisions, risks surface early and interdependent programmes delivery at a global scale, shaping how learning services and technology evolve across the enterprise.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio strategy, integration and planning: Define and lead the portfolio’s end-to-end delivery approach, integrated master plan, operating model, decision rights and pathways. Translate strategic priorities into sequenced programme outcomes, with the global LMS replacement as the immediate delivery priority, while maintaining momentum across Learning Content Services and the learning ecosystem refresh. Direct Programme Managers and the PMO, align resources and suppliers, and maintain robust baselines, and change control.

Global LMS delivery, compliance and operational readiness: Hold portfolio-level accountability for orchestrating and assuring the successful delivery of the global LMS replacement as a critical licence-to-operate programme. Direct integrated delivery across business, IT, Quality, data, suppliers, change and operations, ensuring effective control of validation, migration, deployment and operational readiness. Safeguard compliance, data integrity and service continuity, and enable a controlled transition to live operation and sustained adoption.

Content Services and learning ecosystem transformation: Lead and assure the delivery of AI-enabled Learning Content Services and the refresh of the wider learning technology ecosystem. Ensure each programme has clear outcomes, accountable leadership, delivery plans and controls, and that technology, content, data, process and service-design decisions remain aligned across the portfolio.

Governance, assurance and systemic risk: Establish and implement proportionate governance, delivery controls, stage gates and escalation thresholds across the portfolio. Oversee risks, issues and cross-programme dependencies' end to end, resolving recurring concerns at source and raising material decisions and trade-offs with evidence-based recommendations.

Financial, resource and commercial control: Lead all aspects of portfolio budgets, forecasts, capacity and supplier performance, ensuring investment and resources remain aligned to delivery priorities. Partner with Finance, Procurement and People teams to handle constraints and variances and recommend timely trade-offs across programmes.

Performance, executive insight and value: Lead the portfolio performance and benefits framework, providing a forward-looking view of delivery, readiness, compliance, adoption and value. Translate complexity into clear choices for the Global Head of Enterprise Learning Services and Solutions and governance forums, and provide service owners with the evidence required for transition, operational acceptance and benefits realisation.

Organisational leadership and delivery capability: Build a high-performing Programme Management and PMO community with clear accountability and consistently applied delivery standards. Strengthen capability through development, organisational design and resourcing, while ensuring effective succession, knowledge transfer and delivery continuity.

 

Requirements:

Bachelors degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in programme management, project management, business, technology, learning, HR, organizational change, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or recognised programme or portfolio management certification is desirable.

Senior programme or portfolio leadership experience delivering complex, global, technology-enabled transformation.

Hands on experience leading the implementation or replacement of a global LMS, HR platform or comparable business-critical enterprise system, including delivery in a regulated environment.

Strong understanding of the delivery controls required for validation, data migration, compliance, operational readiness and transition of a business-critical global platform.

Ability to establish integrated portfolio plans, operating models, governance, performance management and execution at enterprise scale.

Experience leading a complex, multi-year transformation portfolio from strategy through to delivery, including defining the operating model, integrated master plan, decision rights, and governance.

Experience leading Programme Managers and PMO professionals, building organisational capability and delivering outcomes through others.

Experience integrating delivery across business, technology, data, Quality, suppliers, change and operations.

Executive presence and commercial judgement, with the ability to present evidence-based recommendations and make informed trade-offs.

 

In Office Requirement:

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

 

Competitive salary and benefits package on offer!

The successful candidate will have access to a flexible employee benefits fund, including holiday purchase and flexible time off, pension contributions, Share Save Plans, A performance recognition scheme and a competitive, generous remuneration package!

title: Senior Implementation Consultant (French)
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Our Implementations and Onboarding team is responsible for understanding the relationships and desired outcomes established during the sales process, building a launch plan for success, and helping customers get the most out of 1Password's suite of products.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will lead the technical deployment and customer enablement of 1Password's product suite for our largest and most strategically important enterprise customers. You will own the hands-on configuration and rollout of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, Device Trust and Unified Access while delivering tailored, high-impact training that drives deep adoption and long-term customer value. Partnering with a Project Manager, Technical Account Managers, and Solutions Architects, you will be the trusted authority in each engagement, bringing both advanced product expertise and sharp business acumen to complex, high-visibility deployments. You will approach your work as an AI builder by actively developing AI-powered workflows and automation to scale your impact, accelerate outcomes for customers, and raise the standard for what implementation excellence looks like at 1Password.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

What we're looking for:

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to engage and develop relationships, sharing information effectively across all professional levels.

  • Excellent communication in Spanish is a plus

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical implementation, solutions engineering, customer onboarding, or related B2B SaaS function, with a demonstrated track record of leading enterprise software deployments for large, complex, or strategically critical organizations

  • Advanced technical expertise and hands-on experience deploying SaaS products in enterprise environments, including deep working knowledge of identity providers (IdPs), SSO, SCIM, Active Directory, MDM, device trust, and Zero Trust security frameworks

  • Expert-level understanding of the business cases for enterprise security, IT operations, and SaaS governance tools and able to fluently navigate both technical and strategic conversations with IT administrators, security teams, and C-suite stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, high-visibility enterprise engagements with multiple competing priorities, maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines

  • Proven ability to design and deliver advanced, engaging virtual training and enablement programs for enterprise customers, including technically sophisticated administrators and executive audiences

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leadership and serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders

  • Strong judgment in identifying and resolving technical issues, with the ability to lead de-escalation efforts and drive outcomes autonomously

  • A builder's mindset toward AI. You actively develop with AI tools and automation, creating workflows, solutions, and accelerators that meaningfully improve how you and your team work; you are not a casual user but a practitioner who builds

  • Experience mentoring and coaching peers and junior team members, sharing expertise and elevating the capability of those around you

  • Familiarity with SCIM, AD/LDAP, CLI, SSO, BYOD, MDM, SaaS discovery, and device posture concepts

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 1Password or experience deploying identity and access management, password management, device trust, or SaaS management solutions at enterprise scale

What you can expect:

  • Drive the successful technical implementation and deployment of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, and Device Trust (and Unified Access as it becomes available) for large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, owning hands-on configuration, integration, and validation through to a successful launch

  • Partner with the assigned Project Manager to align on timelines, dependencies, and internal coordination. You own the technical delivery and customer enablement while the Project Manager owns project coordination; together you ensure a seamless, high-quality customer experience

  • Collaborate closely with Technical Account Managers and Solutions Architects to assess customer environments, align on architectural decisions, and design implementation approaches that meet both technical requirements and business objectives

  • Build deep knowledge of each customer's environment, security posture, business goals, and user workflows in order to design deployment strategies and training plans that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes

  • Deliver advanced, customized virtual training sessions for enterprise administrators and end users across all deployed 1Password products while adapting instructional approaches to technically diverse audiences and highly complex organizational environments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for customers and internal stakeholders alike, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from IT and security teams to executive leadership

  • Manage escalated situations on complex or sensitive implementations, working cross-functionally with internal teams and engaging directly with customers to de-escalate and drive the best possible outcome

  • Exercise independent judgment in identifying and mitigating implementation risks, developing and executing resolution strategies proactively and keeping all relevant stakeholders informed

  • Stay ahead of product updates, new features, and evolving integrations across our products and applying that knowledge immediately in customer engagements and sharing it with the broader team

  • Develop and maintain advanced implementation playbooks, training curricula, and enablement resources (including configuration guides, deployment frameworks, and possibly video content) that elevate the capabilities of the entire Implementations and Onboarding team

  • Mentor Implementation Managers and other junior team members, sharing deep product expertise, enterprise deployment strategies, and insights gained from working with our most demanding customers

  • Influence team operations by leveraging lessons from complex engagements to recommend and drive improvements to team practices, processes, documentation, and the overall customer journey

  • Build with AI not just use it. Actively develop AI-powered workflows, automation, and tools that improve your own delivery, help customers achieve faster time-to-value, and create scalable solutions the broader team can adopt

  • Contribute significantly to the growth strategy of the Implementations function, identifying opportunities to evolve how we deploy and enable customers at scale

  • Occasionally represent 1Password at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £61,000 GBP and £88,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Head of People Operations
description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

Lead the Hub Model

  • Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

  • Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

  • Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

  • Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

  • Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

  • Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

  • Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads

Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

  • Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

  • Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

  • People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

  • Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

  • Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

  • Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

  • You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

  • Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

  • Build hub teams that operate autonomously — no daily hand-holding required

Manage the Operational Realities

  • Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

  • Local compliance and employment framework adherence, in partnership with Compliance

  • Office and facilities baseline across hub locations — in coordination with Workplace & Experience on standards

Build AI-Native Operations

  • Default to automation for employee queries, document generation, onboarding workflows, and operational logistics

  • Build self-service so people don't need to contact us for anything a good system can answer

  • Treat AI adoption within the function as infrastructure and a performance metric

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • Hub teams operating autonomously across all locations — you're steering, not executing day-to-day

  • Every hub has OKRs, knows what winning looks like, and can tell if they hit it

  • Employee lifecycle is consistent and increasingly automated across all locations

  • Cross-functional interfaces with Payroll, Tech, Compliance, W&E are clean and frictionless

  • Knowledge base live and current in a single source of truth

  • AI and automation handle the majority of repeatable operational tasks inside the function

  • Every hub partner owns their roadmap — not just their to-do list

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

Experience & Background

  • 10+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or Operations leadership in multinational environments

  • Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

  • Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

  • Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

  • Strong change management experience — organizational transitions handled with operational rigor and human care

  • Experience in fast-scaling tech environments — SaaS and start-up / scale-up required

Skills & Mindset

  • Systems thinker: you see how processes connect, where the friction is, and what the fix is

  • AI-native operating instinct: you treat every new process as a question of which system or agent should own it

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: non-linear situations with predictable outcomes

  • Stakeholder management: you go and solve, not email and wait

  • Cross-cultural judgment: you understand employment realities across NL, ES, BR, AM, US — or learn fast when you don't

  • Executive presence: you partner with senior leadership and personally own the hardest operational calls

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

  • 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: instead of a fixed set of perks, you get a flexible benefits budget you can direct across the things that matter most — health, wellbeing, family, and your home office among them. Within these areas, the choice is yours.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota

  • 🌎 Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Tools like Claude and OpenAI are available by default, and we genuinely back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. It's a toolkit that's well ahead of the market, and you'll have it from day one.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.
